objects.name: Analytic 1919
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies remote Windows system-information queries using WMI/CIM, WinRM, PowerShell remoting, or equivalent management tooling where the command names a non-local target and the account/source is outside the approved management baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
